gaps: The continuation page of Fig. 4.1 (outputs part 2) is blank in the text extraction, so the DIRECT EMISSIONS to air and water of ceramic production (dust, fluorides, waste-water loads) could not be read - only the waste flows of part 1 are available.
No waste-water treatment input appears although 0.541 kg of tap water and 10.6 l of well water are consumed.
Several output lines ('paper', 'gypsum', 'clay suspension') are marked as recycled without an assigned ecoinvent module, so they carry no burden here.
